name: Roblox Talent Show ☀️
desc:
🎤 Welcome to Roblox Talent Show, the largest and most innovative talent competition game on the Roblox platform! Present your talent in front of the Judges and earn a rating based on your performance!

🎃 Halloween Event (until Oct 31)
-Monsters roam the venue for 15 minutes every hour. Walk up to one and press E to fight.
-Beat minigames to win pumpkins!
Spend them in the Event Shop on Halloween!

⭐ Levels
-Earn XP by performing, judging, hosting and playing. Level up to unlock titles, name colours and trails, all the way to level 100.
- Daily and weekly quests for bonus XP

🎹 Piano on Practice Maps
-Practice maps now work with the piano.

Within Roblox Talent Show, you can:
🎉 Take the stage in front of the Judges!
😃 Become the Host and manage the game!
❤️ Audition alongside your friends!
💸 Receive Robux donations as a performer from other players!

💕 Group Link: https://www.roblox.com/groups/2794002/Talent-Show-Group
📝 Game Rules: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/1706902
